# LineLab Game Engine + Difficulty-Scaled Bots

## 1) Engine data shapes (`frontend/lib/game/types.ts`)

```ts
type Star = 1 | 2 | 3;
interface FieldUnit { uid:string; key:string; tier:1|2|3|4|5; star:Star;
  traits:string[]; role:"carry"|"frontline"|"flex"; items:string[]; pos:number|null } // pos 0..(level-1) on board, null=bench
interface PlayerState {
  id:string; isHero:boolean; hp:number; gold:number; level:1|9; xp:number;
  streak:number; // signed
  board:FieldUnit[]; bench:FieldUnit[]; shop:(string|null)[]; // 5 slots, null=bought/empty
  itemBank:string[];     // unattached completed modules
  diff:DiffTier|null;    // bots only
}
interface Pool { copies:Record<string,number> } // key -> remaining; init from POOL_COPIES_PER_UNIT[tier]
interface GameState { seed:number; rng:RNG; round:number; stage:2|7; roundInStage:0|4;
  phase:"plan"|"locked"|"combat"|"resolve"; players:PlayerState[]; // [hero, ...7 bots]
  pool:Pool; carouselRounds:number[]; log:RoundLog[] }
```
RNG = a seeded `mulberry32(seed)` — **all** randomness (shop draws, bot rolls, combat samples, opponent pairing) pulls from this single stream so a fixed seed replays byte-identically. Persist `seed` + the ordered action list for review.

## 2) Round / phase cycle

`plan` (hero buys/sells/rolls/levels/places freely) → **Lock** → `combat`: pair players (round-robin schedule; odd one fights a ghost = a snapshot of a random alive board, no damage) → `resolve`: loser HP −= `STAGE_BASE_DAMAGE[stage] + survivors`, update streak, eliminations (lowest HP = worst open placement) → **income**: `gold += 5 + interest + streakBonus + (won?1:0)`, `xp += 2` → `roundInStage++`; at 5 advance stage. Stages 2..7. Carousel item rounds: insert at `roundInStage===0` of stages 3/4/6 — each player picks 1 unit-on-component in worst-HP-first order.

## 3) Player actions & effects

- **Buy unit**: `gold -= tier` (cost = tier 1..5). Auto-combine on 3rd copy → 2★ (consumes 3), on 9th → 3★. Goes to bench; rejected if bench full (9) and no combine.
- **Sell**: refund = `tier * star`−(1 if star>1 else 0) buy-back convention → use refund table `{1★:tier, 2★:3*tier−1, 3★:9*tier−2}`; **return all pool copies** (1/3/9) to `pool`, drop items to `itemBank`.
- **Refresh**: `gold -= 2`, redraw all 5 slots (see §4); returns prior unbought slots' copies are NOT consumed (only buying consumes pool).
- **Buy XP**: `gold -= 4; xp += 4`; level up while `xp >= XP_TO_NEXT[level]` (`{1:2,2:2,3:6,4:10,5:20,6:36,7:60,8:68}`), max 9.
- **Place/move/bench**: free; board count ≤ level.

## 4) Shop draw algorithm

```
for each of 5 slots:
  r = rng()  // pick tier via SHOP_ODDS[level] cumulative
  tier = firstTierWhere(cumsum >= r*100)
  candidates = ROSTER_BY_TIER[tier].filter(u => pool.copies[u.key] > 0)
  if empty: slot=null; continue
  // weight by remaining copies (depletion makes contested units rarer)
  pick weighted by pool.copies[key]; slot = key
```
Pool only decremented on **purchase** (`copies[key] -= 1`), restored on sell. 3★ needs 9 of one unit from the shared depletable pool — exactly mirrors `POOL_COPIES_PER_UNIT {1:30,2:25,3:18,4:10,5:9}`.

## 5) Visible-but-abstract combat (mirror `combat_model.py`)

```
boardStrength(p) = Σ_units unitStr + traitBonuses + itemStrength
unitStr = TIER_BASE[tier] * STAR_MULT[star]    // TIER_BASE {1:6,2:9,3:13,4:18,5:24}, STAR_MULT {1:1,2:1.8,3:3.2}
itemStrength = Σ MODULES_BY_KEY[m].strength      // 5.0..9.5 from items.py
```
Win: `pWin = 1/(1+exp(-(selfStr − oppStr + noise)/12))`, noise = `gauss(0,4)` per side (WINPROB_SCALE=12). Sample `rng() < pWin`. UI: flash both strength scalars, a rolling bar, WIN/LOSS. HP loss = `STAGE_BASE_DAMAGE[stage] + (1 + min(8, max(0,margin)/6))` rounded.

## 6) Trait activation (mirror `traits.py`)

Count distinct units per trait on the **fielded board only** (a unit counts once per trait regardless of star; duplicate copies don't double-count). `traitBonus = highest satisfied breakpoint`. Breakpoints verbatim: Pyre `{2:4,4:11,6:22}`, Tide `{2:4,4:10,6:20}`, Storm `{2:5,3:10,4:18}`, Drift `{3:6,5:15}`, Forge `{2:4,4:12,6:21}`, Marksman `{2:5,4:13}`, Warden `{2:5,4:12,6:20}`, Mystic `{2:4,4:11}`, Skirmisher `{2:4,4:10,6:18}`. Display: chip per trait `name n/nextBreakpoint`, lit when ≥ first breakpoint (use `chip`/`seg-on`/`seg-off` classes).

## 7) Item mechanic

Carousel/PvE drops a **component** (8 from `COMPONENTS`); 2 components fuse → a `Module` (8 modules, strength 5.0–9.5, classes offensive/defensive/utility). Attach ≤3 per unit → adds `module.strength` to that unit. **Slam-vs-hold** coach uses `slam_value(stage,hp,committed) = clamp(0.45*max(0,(6−stage)/4) + 0.45*max(0,(75−hp)/75) + (committed?0.25:0), 0,1)`; ≥0.55 → "slam now."

## 8) Bot decision policy (reuses §3 rules)

Per plan phase, each bot runs the same `_baseline_policy` shape: target level by stage `{2:4,3:5,4:6,5:7,6:8,7:8}`; if `hp<35 && gold≥2` roll all gold to stabilize; elif `gold>54` roll down to 50 (don't waste interest); else level toward target keeping reserve 6, then bank. Buying: greedily buy any shop unit that completes a combine or extends its largest trait; place highest-strength `level` units. Strength growth per roll mirrors the rollout: `gain = 14*(1−exp(−0.22*expectedUseful)) * noise * headroomFactor`, then translated into concrete buys.

## 9) Difficulty tiers (`DIFF`)

| Tier | econOpt | levelTempo | rollDiscipline (reserve floor) | mistakeRate | luckMult (upgrade hit ×) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Casual | 0.45 | −1 lvl behind | rolls to 0 randomly | 0.35 | 0.80 |
| Easy | 0.65 | −1 lvl | floor 0 | 0.20 | 0.90 |
| Even | 0.85 | on curve | floor 10/keep interest | 0.10 | 1.00 |
| Hard | 0.95 | on curve | floor 20, interest-aware | 0.04 | 1.12 |
| Pro | 1.00 | solver curve | follows `/api/compare` best_key line | 0.01 | 1.25 |

`mistakeRate` = chance a bot picks a non-optimal action (skip a combine, mis-level). `luckMult` scales `noise` mean in the roll-gain formula. **Pro** bots, once per plan phase, build their own `StateInput` (§10) and follow `best_key` (save/level/roll-to-floor). Difficulty is a **separate slider** from the hero's UI tier — store as `state.botDiff`, independent of any coach precision setting.

## 10) State → solver `/api/compare` mapping (inverse of `evaluator.initial_strength`)

```
stage: stageNumber<=2?"early": <=4?"midgame":"late"
ratio = heroBoardStrength / stage_baseline_strength(stage)   // baseline = 20+14*(stage−2)
board_strength: ratio<0.92?"weak": ratio>1.07?"strong":"medium"   // inverse of BOARD_STRENGTH_MULT {0.85,1.0,1.13}
bench_value: benchUnitCount<=1?"low": <=3?"medium":"high"
pairs: count of bench/board units sitting at exactly 2 copies (0..6)
items: itemBank.length+attached <=1?"low": <=3?"medium":"high"   // mirrors ITEMS_STRENGTH {0,4,8}
lobby_tempo: avg(alive bot strength)/baseline <0.98?"low": >1.06?"high":"medium"  // inverse LOBBY_TEMPO_MULT
goal: user setting (top4|first)
```
Send `{hp, gold, level}` raw. Live coach POSTs this each plan phase; review re-derives per-round from the deterministic replay (same seed ⇒ identical states), so coach advice and post-game review reference the same `best_key`/`ev_score`.

**Key files**: engine `frontend/lib/game/{types,engine,shop,combat,traits,bots,solverMap}.ts`; constants imported from a shared `frontend/lib/game/config.ts` that mirrors `backend/app/config.py` so values can't drift.

# TASK B — LineLab Post-Game Review ("Line Review")

## 1) Decision points: definition + capture

A **decision point (DP)** = any round where the player *commits gold/XP to a macro line* before the next combat. We log one DP per shop/plan phase plus "notable buys."

**What triggers a DP record (client-side, during the live game or a replay import):**
- **Plan-phase commit** — at end of every shop phase, classify the net actions taken since the last combat into one macro line `key` matching the solver's vocabulary: `save`, `level_{L+1}`, `roll_{30|20|10|0}`, `level_{L+1}_roll_{floor}`. Mapping rule: if XP bought to cross a level → `level_*`; rerolls spent down to floor F (rounded to nearest of 30/20/10/0) → `roll_F`; both → combo; neither → `save`.
- **Notable buy** — a single purchase that (a) completes a pair→2★ or 6th copy→3★, (b) is a tier IV/V unit, or (c) is an item-component slam. Flagged but graded as a *sub-event* (see §3 forced/context case), not a full solver call.

**Captured record shape (one per DP):**
```ts
type DecisionRecord = {
  id: string; stage: number; round: number;       // e.g. 4-2
  pre: StateInput;                                  // EXACT solver input snapshot
  action_key: string; action_label: string;        // the committed line
  gold_spent: number; xp_bought: number; rerolls: number;
  buys: Array<{unitTier:1|2|3|4|5; star:1|2|3; isItemSlam:boolean}>;
  boardHash: string;                                // replay hook (see §5)
};
```
`pre` is a verbatim `StateInput` (`stage,hp,gold,level,board_strength,bench_value,pairs,items,lobby_tempo,goal`) sampled *before* any gold is spent that round. `board_strength`/`bench_value`/`items` are bucketed by the client's heuristic (strength scalar vs `stage_baseline_strength`). Save the same `seed` determinism guarantee: identical `pre` → identical solver result, so reviews are reproducible.

## 2) Grading algorithm

For each DP, call `POST /api/compare { state: pre, n_rollouts: 3000 }`. Then:

- **Locate the played line** in `results` by `action_key`. If absent (e.g. player rolled to 25 → no exact `roll_20`), pick the **nearest** by gold-floor distance, then by `ev_score` proximity; flag `matched:"nearest"`.
- Let `B` = best line (`results[best_key]`), `P` = played line.
- **Goal-normalized EV gap** (so `top4` 0–5 and `first` 0–12 scales are comparable):
  - `evMax = goal=="first" ? 12 : 5`
  - `gapEV = (B.ev_score − P.ev_score) / evMax`   ∈ [0,1]
- **Placement gap:** `gapPlace = P.expected_placement − B.expected_placement` (≥0, in placement units).
- **Combined per-move loss:**
  ```
  L = 0.70 * gapEV + 0.30 * clamp(gapPlace / 2.0, 0, 1)
  ```
  (divide placement gap by 2.0 so a "2 full placements worse" move saturates the placement term). `L ∈ [0,1]`, higher = worse.
- **Trap detection:** compute `tempting = ev_score of the highest-ev *non-best* line that is also "obvious"` (a `save` or single-`level` line — the lazy default). `trapGap = (B.ev_score − tempting)/evMax`. A spot is a **TRAP** when `trapGap ≥ 0.12` AND the player picked B.
- **Forced/only-line:** spot is **FORCED** when the 2nd-best line's `L ≥ 0.18` for *every* alternative, i.e. `min over alternatives of their loss ≥ 0.18` (only one line is acceptable). If player picked B here → special label.

## 3) Label scale (original names, exact thresholds)

Evaluated per DP in this order (first match wins). Colors fit the ink/emerald theme.

| Name | Meaning (one line) | Threshold | Hex |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Keystone** | Found the clearly-best line in a trap spot | played==B **and** TRAP (`trapGap ≥ 0.12`) | `#34d399` (brand emerald) |
| **Pure Line** | Hit the only acceptable line in a forced spot | played==B **and** FORCED | `#5eead4` (teal-300) |
| **Optimal** | Best (or tied-best) line, normal spot | `L ≤ 0.02` | `#4ade80` (green-400) |
| **Solid** | Clearly fine, near-best | `0.02 < L ≤ 0.06` | `#a3e635` (lime-400) |
| **Loose** | Playable but leaks a little EV | `0.06 < L ≤ 0.14` | `#facc15` (amber-400) |
| **Slip** | Real mistake; better line was clear | `0.14 < L ≤ 0.28` | `#fb923c` (orange-400) |
| **Misline** | Punishing error / griefs the spot | `L > 0.28` | `#f87171` (red-400) |

Notable-buy sub-events get a lightweight 3-state chip (no solver call): **On-Pool** (correct upgrade/slam), **Hold-It** (slammed an item that should've been held for BIS — flagged when `items=="high"` already and tier-IV+ board absent), **Pool-Bleed** (over-bought low-tier copies past 3rd while level cap unused). These render smaller, in `#818cf8` indigo, and don't affect the move count for accuracy except as a −2 each cap.

## 4) Per-game accuracy + summary

- **Per-move quality** `q_i = 100 * (1 − L_i)`; Keystone/Pure Line force `q_i = 100`.
- **Game accuracy** (weight late/high-stakes moves more — a misline at 6-5 matters more than 2-1):
  ```
  w_i = stage_i                       // stage 2..7 as weight
  Accuracy = round( Σ(w_i * q_i) / Σ w_i )
  ```
  Then subtract notable-buy penalties: `Accuracy = clamp(Accuracy − 2*nBadBuys, 0, 100)`.
- **Bands:** 0–59 Developing · 60–74 Steady · 75–86 Sharp · 87–94 Refined · 95–100 Surgical.
- **Main-leak detection:** bucket each DP's loss by `(phase, line-family)`. The bucket with the largest `Σ w_i*L_i` names the leak, mapped to copy:
  - early + `save`/over-econ → *"Greedy early — bled HP holding gold."*
  - midgame + `level_*` losses → *"Weak midgame stabilization — leveled when the board needed strength."*
  - midgame + missed `roll` → *"Slow to roll — sat on gold past the stabilize window."*
  - late + `roll_0` losses → *"Over-rolled the endgame — all-in'd a spot that wanted level/econ."*
- **Study link:** deep-link to the solver pre-loaded with the worst single DP's `pre`: `/solver?from=review&dp={id}` (hydrates `ScenarioBuilder` with that `StateInput`), plus a "Drill this phase" CTA filtering to that line-family.

## 5) Review UX

- **Move timeline** (left rail): vertical list, one row per DP `stage-round`, line label + label chip (name + hex dot). Notable buys nest under their DP as smaller indigo chips. Reuse existing `chip`/`label` classes; chip bg = `color@14%`, text = color.
- **EV line graph** (top): x = move index, y = **expected placement inverted** (8 at bottom → 1 at top, so "up = better"). Two series: **played** (solid emerald) vs **best-available** (dashed indigo, `B.expected_placement` per DP). The vertical gap visualizes lost equity; Slip/Misline points get a colored marker. Hover shows tooltip `q_i`, `gapEV`, `gapPlace`. Render in the same dark card; mono numerals via `num`.
- **Click a move → detail drawer:** renders the full solver payload for that DP — reuse `EVTable` (all `results` ranked), `DecisionTree` (the `branches`), and `ExplanationPanel` (the line's `explanation`). Highlight the played row and the best row; add an **"Play instead"** callout: best `label` + its one-line explanation + the `gapEV`/`gapPlace` you gave up.
- **Board-state replay hook:** each DP carries `boardHash`; drawer has a "Replay board" button calling `getBoardSnapshot(boardHash)` to re-render the committed board/bench (read-only). Stubbed now as `() => boardHash` so the panel ships before full replay storage exists.

## 6) Detail scaling by learning tier

Tie verbosity to a `learningTier` (stored on profile; default by lifetime games: <20 → Novice, 20–80 → Adept, >80 → Expert):

- **Novice:** show only **Keystone / Slip / Misline** chips (hide Loose/Solid noise); timeline collapsed to the 3 worst moves; summary = one leak sentence + one study CTA. Threshold: surface a move only if `L ≥ 0.14` *or* it's a Keystone.
- **Adept:** full 7-label scale; EV graph on; drawer shows top-3 solver lines only; surface moves with `L ≥ 0.06`.
- **Expert:** everything — all `results`, branches, `risk`, `ev_score`/placement deltas as raw numerals, trap/forced annotations, and per-buy sub-grades; no move hidden (`L ≥ 0` shown). Also unlocks "what-if": re-run `/api/compare` with the *line you actually played* promoted, to show the downstream divergence.

# LineLab — Learning-Tier Gating Matrix (Beginner → Standard → Pro)

State key: `learnTier: "beginner" | "standard" | "pro"` (default `standard`), persisted in localStorage `linelab.learnTier`. Independent of `botDifficulty`. Drives a single `gating[learnTier]` config object consumed by game UI, solver request builder, and review screen.

## 1) Game controls & panels visible per tier

| Element | Beginner | Standard | Pro |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shop (5 slots) | Simplified: tier color + cost only | Full + tier-odds tooltip on hover | Full + inline raw odds row from `SHOP_ODDS[level]` |
| Reroll button | Shows cost (2g); confirm if gold<10 | Plain reroll | Reroll + live "copies left in pool" (`POOL_COPIES_PER_UNIT`) |
| Buy-XP button | "Level up (4g)" + XP-to-next bar | + numeric XP `cur/need` | + passive +2/round & gold-to-next-2-levels |
| Gold/HP/Stage HUD | Large, always shown | Standard | Standard + interest tier dots (10/20/30/40/50) |
| Interest hint | Always: "+Xg interest, +1 at next 10" | On hover | Raw `floor(gold/10)` capped 5 |
| Streak meter | Hidden | Shown (+1@3/+2@5/+3@6) | Shown + projected streak gold |
| Trait/breakpoint panel | Active-trait badges only + "1 more for bonus" nudge | Full breakpoint list | Full + contested/pool-depletion warnings |
| Item drag-to-unit | **Hidden** (auto-suggest "slam" only) | Drag enabled, 3/unit | Drag + "hold for BIS" component planner |
| Bench | Visible, no value cue | + "bench pairs" highlight | + `bench_value` proxy & latent-strength note |
| Goal toggle (top4/first) | Locked to top4 | Visible | Visible + per-goal reward weights |

## 2) Solver "coach" verbosity per tier

| | Beginner | Standard | Pro |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lines shown | **1** (`best_key` only) | **Top 3** by `ev_score` | **All** (up to 6) |
| Metrics per line | none (plain text) | `top4_rate %` + `expected_placement` | full row: top4/first/bot4/ev_score/risk |
| "Why" | 1-sentence `explanation`, plain English + 1 interest/HP nudge | full `explanation` string | `explanation` + raw `ev_score` delta vs best |
| Decision tree (`branches`) | Hidden | Collapsed ("if you win/lose next fight…") | Expanded `DecisionTree.tsx`, both branches + probs |
| Components used | `ExplanationPanel` (single) | `EVTable` (3 rows) + `PlacementBar` | `EVTable` (all) + `DecisionTree` + `PlacementBar` + seed |
| `summary` | shown as headline | shown | shown + `seed` for reproducibility |

## 3) Solver inputs exposed vs locked-to-default (maps to Economy/Tempo/Full ladder)

POST `/api/compare` always sends all 10 fields; locked ones use these defaults.

| Input | Ladder | Beginner | Standard | Pro |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stage` | Economy | **exposed** | exposed | exposed |
| `hp` | Economy | exposed | exposed | exposed |
| `gold` | Economy | exposed | exposed | exposed |
| `level` | Tempo | lock → derived from game (else `6`) | exposed | exposed |
| `board_strength` | Tempo | lock → `"medium"` | exposed | exposed |
| `lobby_tempo` | Tempo | lock → `"medium"` | exposed | exposed |
| `pairs` | Full | lock → `0` | lock → `0` | exposed (0–6) |
| `items` | Full | lock → `"medium"` | lock → `"medium"` | exposed |
| `bench_value` | Full | lock → `"low"` | lock → `"medium"` | exposed |
| `goal` | Full | lock → `"top4"` | exposed | exposed |

Locked inputs render as a greyed `chip` reading "auto: medium" so the value is transparent, not hidden.

## 4) Action-space granularity (the GTO-simplification idea)

The backend already generates fine lines (`save`, `level_N`, `roll_{30,20,10,0}`, combos). Filter client-side by tier before display; the request is unchanged.

| Tier | Lines surfaced | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| Beginner | **3 coarse**: Save · Roll · Level. "Roll" = the best of `roll_*` collapsed to one button. | Map every `roll_{floor}` → single "Roll" label = top-`ev_score` roll line; drop combos. |
| Standard | **Save · Level · Roll-to-floor (best floor named, e.g. "Roll to 20")** | Show `save`, `level_N`, and best single `roll_{floor}`; hide combos. |
| Pro | **Full**: `roll_30/20/10/0 (all-in)` + `level_N + roll` combos, up to 6 | Pass through `results` unfiltered. |

Collapse logic: Beginner picks `argmax ev_score` within each of {save},{level_*},{roll_*}; labels stay generic ("Roll") so the player learns the *category* decision before the *floor* decision.

## 5) Onboarding & post-game review scaling

| | Beginner | Standard | Pro |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tooltips | On by default, dwell 300ms, plain English | On hover | Off (toggle to enable raw-data tooltips) |
| Guided first game | Forced 1-game scripted walkthrough (buy/level/roll prompts) | Optional "tips" overlay, dismissible | None |
| "Why" callouts | Pulsing callout on each recommended action | Inline coach panel | Silent; coach on demand |
| Post-game review | 3 "key moments": biggest HP swing, an econ miss, a good roll — each with the line you took vs `best_key` | Round-by-round top4% delta chart + 5 flagged spots | Full per-round EV log, every line's `ev_score`, `seed`, replayable into ScenarioBuilder |
| Re-run in solver | One-click "ask the coach" on the flagged moment | Same | Same + edit-and-resolve |

## 6) Bot-difficulty pairing & two-slider interaction

Pairing is **suggested, not forced** — selecting a learning tier pre-selects a bot tier the user can override.

| Learning tier | Suggested `lobby_tempo` / bot difficulty | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Beginner | `low` tempo, "Casual" bots | Slower lobby = more forgiving HP/econ mistakes |
| Standard | `medium` tempo, "Ranked" bots | Matches solver default scenario |
| Pro | `high` tempo, "Expert" bots (+ spikes) | Punishes tempo errors the Pro UI exposes |

**UI interaction:** two stacked segmented controls in Settings — top "Learning" (`seg`), bottom "Bot difficulty" (`seg`). Changing Learning shows a one-line `text-slate-500` nudge: "Suggested bots: Casual — [keep] [switch]". Never auto-change the bot slider without consent. A small linked-chain `chip` indicates they're currently paired; it greys out the moment the user overrides, signaling independent control.

Files to touch: `frontend/components/solver/controls.tsx` (gated render), new `frontend/lib/gating.ts` (the `gating[tier]` map + line-collapse + request-defaults), `frontend/app/solver/page.tsx` (consume tier), `EVTable.tsx`/`DecisionTree.tsx`/`ExplanationPanel.tsx` (row-count + branch gating). Backend `evaluator.py` needs **no change** — all gating is presentation-layer over the existing 10-input `StateInput` and 6-line candidate set.

## 0) New palette tokens (add to `tailwind.config` + globals)

## 1) /play screen — layout regions
Recommend a **square grid** (cleaner CSS, crisp hit-targets, no hex math; reads more "analytics" than "fantasy"). Hero board **4 rows × 7 cols** (28 cells), opponents abstract so no enemy board shown.

Root: `min-h-screen grid grid-rows-[auto_1fr_auto]` with optional right rail.
- **Top status bar** (`row`, `card` strip, `h-14 px-4 flex items-center gap-6`): segments — `HP <num text-emerald-300>` w/ inline mini-bar, `Gold <num text-amber-300>` + interest dots (●●●●● filled per 10g), `Lvl <num>` + thin XP-to-next bar (`h-1 bg-indigo-400`), `Streak` flame chip, right-aligned `Stage 4-2` (`.num`). Sticky `top-0 z-30`.
- **Center column** (`max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 grid gap-3`):
  - **Opponents rail** — horizontal strip above board, `flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto`, 7 mini-avatar tiles (`w-16 card`): hex-mask avatar, HP micro-bar, name; **next opponent** gets `ring-tier-2` + `animate-pulse` glow + "VS" tag.
  - **BOARD** — `grid grid-cols-7 grid-rows-4 gap-1.5 aspect-[7/4]`, cells `rounded-lg bg-ink-900/50 border border-ink-700/60`; empty cells show faint dot; drop-target cells `ring-1 ring-brand/40`. Hex-feel optional via subtle `clip-path` but square default.
  - **BENCH** — `grid grid-cols-9 gap-1.5`, 9 slots, `bg-ink-900/40`, slightly smaller than board cells.
  - **SHOP row** — `grid grid-cols-5 gap-2`, taller cards; left actions cluster `Refresh (2g)` `btn-ghost`, `Buy XP (4g)` `btn-ghost`, lock toggle; right `Ready/Lock` `btn-primary`. Shop has subtle top emerald hairline `border-t border-brand/20`.
- **Right COACH panel** (collapsible, `w-80 shrink-0 card`): header "Coach", EV verdict chip, best-move callout, top-4 / first rates (`.num`), mini branch list. Toggle button `btn-ghost` pins/unpins; collapses to a 44px vertical tab with a brand dot.

**Responsive:** desktop-first `lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px]`. `<1280px` coach becomes a slide-over drawer (right). `<900px` opponents rail scrolls, bench wraps to 2 rows, shop becomes `grid-cols-5` shrinking → horizontal scroll under ~520px. Status bar collapses streak/interest into a popover.

## 2) Unit-card visual (`UnitCard.tsx`)
`relative rounded-lg p-1.5 bg-ink-800/80` with **tier ring** `ring-tier-N`. Top-left **cost** chip (`chip .num` + tier-colored dot). Top-right **star row**: 1-3 `★` `text-amber-300` (2-star slightly larger, 3-star adds `drop-shadow` gold glow). Bottom **trait pips**: small rounded squares colored per origin/role (tooltip on hover). **Item slots**: 3 tiny `w-3 h-3 rounded-sm border border-ink-600` along bottom edge, filled = module color.
- **Hover:** `-translate-y-0.5 ring-offset-2`, raised shadow, tooltip card with strength delta.
- **Selected:** persistent `ring-2 ring-brand`, faint emerald inner glow `shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_#34d399]`.

## 3) Combat / round transitions (CSS-only)
- **VS flash:** full-board `::after` overlay, emerald→indigo radial `opacity-0 → 0.6 → 0`, 600ms `ease-out` (`animate-[vsflash_.6s]`).
- **HP tick-down:** animate `--hp` width transition `400ms ease-out` + brief red `bg-red-400/40` pulse on the bar; damage number floats up (`translate-y-[-12px] opacity-0`, 700ms).
- **Win/Loss banner:** centered pill, win = `bg-brand text-ink-950` slide-down + settle; loss = `bg-red-500/15 text-red-300 border-red-500/40`; auto-fade 1.5s.
- **Streak flame:** chip with layered amber/orange gradient, `animate-pulse` scaling intensity with streak count (3 = ember, 5 = flame, 6+ = bright + faint flicker keyframe).
Keep all under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion)` → opacity-only.

## 4) The two sliders (learning tier + bot difficulty)
- **Pre-game setup screen** (`SetupScreen.tsx`): centered `card max-w-lg`, two labeled sliders stacked. "Your tier" (Learner→Pro, 1-5) and "Bot difficulty" (Casual→Brutal, 1-5). Track `h-2 rounded-full bg-ink-700`, filled portion `bg-brand` (player) / `bg-indigo-400` (bots), thumb `w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-100 ring-2 ring-ink-950`. Live tick labels + a one-line "what this changes" helper.
- **In-game:** mirrored in a **settings popover** (gear in status bar, `card` anchored dropdown) so they can be retuned between games; changes apply next game with a small note.

## 5) Review page layout (`/review`)
Three-column: `grid lg:grid-cols-[260px_1fr_360px]`.
- **Left — Move timeline** (`MoveTimeline.tsx`): vertical list, each row a `chip-move-{key}` label + round tag + colored left rail (4px) by move type; current step highlighted `bg-ink-800 ring-1 ring-brand/40`; click to scrub.
- **Center — EV + replay**: top **EV area sparkline** (`EVSparkline.tsx`, inline SVG, `stroke-brand fill-brand/15`, baseline at neutral EV, hover crosshair tooltip) spanning the game; below, **board-state replay** reusing `Board` read-only with a transport bar (`◀ ▮ ▶`, step counter `.num`).
- **Right — Solver detail drawer** (`SolverDrawer.tsx`): for the selected move, EV table delta, branch tree (reuse `DecisionTree`), explanation text, "what the solver preferred" diff chip.

## 6) Component breakdown
**`frontend/components/play/`:** `PlayShell.tsx`, `StatusBar.tsx`, `OpponentsRail.tsx`, `OpponentTile.tsx`, `Board.tsx`, `BoardCell.tsx`, `Bench.tsx`, `ShopRow.tsx`, `ShopSlot.tsx`, `UnitCard.tsx`, `ActionBar.tsx`, `CoachPanel.tsx`, `SetupScreen.tsx`, `SettingsPopover.tsx`, `RoundBanner.tsx`, `StreakFlame.tsx`.
**`frontend/components/review/`:** `ReviewShell.tsx`, `MoveTimeline.tsx`, `MoveRow.tsx`, `EVSparkline.tsx`, `BoardReplay.tsx`, `TransportBar.tsx`, `SolverDrawer.tsx`, `PreferredMoveDiff.tsx`.

Shared: extend `globals.css` with `ring-tier-*`, `chip-move-*`, and keyframes `vsflash`, `hptick`, `floatup`, `flicker`. Reuse existing `card / btn-primary / btn-ghost / chip / seg / label / num`. `Board` is shared read-only between play and review to keep replay pixel-identical.
